mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals economic weakness, prompting central bank easing and boosting equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1450 and 690000 respectively indicate demand contraction, triggering policy stimulus and positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1450 and RSAFS < 690000.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, the central bank's rate hikes increase discount rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when the monetary tightening cycle regime is active.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a supply shock, prompting central bank stimulus and boosting equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 signal a housing boom, leading to overvaluation and subsequent equity market corrections, causing negative SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) below 155000 and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.0% indicate labor market contraction, triggering fiscal stimulus and positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 155000 and UNRATE > 3.0.
